# Routine operations {#sec-operations}

## systemd service

Install the included service only when the release is at `/opt/dr-support-screening-poc`:

```bash
cd /opt/dr-support-screening-poc
sudo ./scripts/model-server/install-service.sh
sudo systemctl start dr-support-model-api
sudo systemctl status dr-support-model-api
./scripts/model-server/healthcheck.sh
```

The service runs as `drsupport`, reads `/etc/dr-support/model-server.env`, uses one worker, and starts `scripts/model-server/start.sh`.

Use the following for lifecycle and logs:

```bash
sudo systemctl stop dr-support-model-api
sudo systemctl restart dr-support-model-api
sudo journalctl -u dr-support-model-api -n 100 --no-pager
```

## Connect a workstation

Set `REMOTE_MODEL_URL` on the review workstation to the Model API base URL, for example `http://model-host.example:7860`. Use HTTPS across an untrusted segment. Set `REMOTE_MODEL_TOKEN` through a private environment or secret manager when required. The token is not returned to the UI, stored in SQLite, or logged.

## Daily readiness check

1. Confirm the service is active with `systemctl status`.
2. Run `healthcheck.sh` and confirm `/health` reports `PASS`.
3. Confirm `/v1/models` returns both expected model IDs and verified status.
4. Open the review workstation and check **Models & Audit**.
5. Run a public or synthetic smoke image only when the release acceptance procedure requires it.
